inherentNegatives.fencedWhileParked: asserts runtime.posture.apply is REFUSED with FREED_SLOT_RESTORE_REQUIRED; a lifted fence fails the node
inherentNegatives.slotTaken: asserts the preview and run.resolveDecision both refuse with RESTORE_SLOT_TAKEN and that the preview mutated nothing; an accepted restore fails the node
inherentNegatives.parked: observed failing live twice during development when the park's graceful-exit stop misread an exiting worker (recorded in the round-2 report)
inherentNegatives.consumed: asserts the resolution reported a gate-park restore, consumed the answered decision, and that the engine then acted; the run's STATUS is deliberately not one of those signals, because the restore inside the same call moves it off the status the park preserved
